keyVerseDR: "Watch ye, therefore, praying at all times..." (Lk 21:36)

level1.title: Look Up!
level1.story: Jesus said there will be signs in the sun, moon, and stars. He said, "Stand up! Your rescue is near!" Stay awake and pray always.
level1.heartIntro: Draw inside the heart, then color it!
questions: What did Jesus tell us to do?
How can you get ready for Christmas?
level1.prayer: Jesus, help me be ready for You. Amen.

activity.title: Advent violet
activity.intro: Color the priest's vestment violet for Advent, the time of waiting and praying.
activity.prompt: A priest's chasuble colored violet for Advent, with an Advent wreath beside it

level2.title: Stand Up and Raise Your Heads
level2.story: Jesus said there shall be signs in the sun, and in the moon, and in the stars. People will be afraid, but then they shall see the Son of man coming in a cloud with great power and majesty. Jesus said, "Look up, and lift up your heads, because your redemption is at hand." He warned them not to let their hearts be weighed down with worries of this life. "Watch ye therefore, praying at all times," Jesus said.
level2.keyLine: Watch ye, therefore, praying at all times.
level2.heartIntro: Write 3 ways you can do each, then color the border!
questions: Why can Christians look up with hope?
What will you change to be ready this Advent?
level2.prayer: Lord, keep me watchful and full of hope. Amen.

activity.intro: Match each liturgical color to its season.
